name: polyarthritis overview
title: Polyarthritis (four or more joints): decide inflammatory or degenerative and acute or chronic; acute inflammatory polyarthritis is infection, crystals or early autoimmune disease, and chronic polyarthritis is sorted by its joint pattern into rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, axial spondyloarthropathy and osteoarthritis, each with its own extra-articular clues and targeted tests

nodes.title: FOUR or more joints: inflammatory or degenerative, acute or chronic, and in what PATTERN?
lines: inflamed synovium (synovitis) = swelling, warmth, pain, stiffness · redness only with infection or crystals
every inflammatory arthritis is a CLINICAL diagnosis: history, extra-articular clues, then targeted tests
mono 1 · oligo 2-3 · POLY 4+ joints · inflammatory: autoimmune, infection, crystals · non-inflammatory: osteoarthritis, trauma, avascular necrosis, Charcot, recurrent hemarthrosis, hemochromatosis
history: onset + course · pattern (symmetry; small, large, axial) · risk: age, sex, ethnicity, family history, psoriasis, IBD, CKD · triggers: infection, drugs, injury, diet
look for: synovitis · tenosynovitis · dactylitis · enthesitis · bursitis · deformity (nodes, swan-neck, boutonnière, ulnar deviation)

nodes.title: ACUTE: 6 weeks or less
lines: onset in hours to days

nodes.title: CHRONIC: over 6 weeks · the PATTERN decides
lines: insidious, weeks to months · progressive and additive
also: connective tissue disease, reactive, palindromic, vasculitis, polyarticular JIA, adult-onset Still's, sarcoidosis, drugs

nodes.title: Acute polyarthritis
lines: infection · crystals · early autoimmune

nodes.title: Rheumatoid arthritis
lines: also symmetric: lupus, connective tissue disease

nodes.title: Psoriatic arthritis
lines: also asymmetric: gout, reactive

nodes.title: Axial spondyloarthropathy
lines: e.g. ankylosing spondylitis

nodes.title: Osteoarthritis
lines: DEGENERATIVE, not inflammatory

nodes.title: Causes
lines: • viral or post-infectious (see the MSK INFECTIONS chart)
• polyarticular gout · rheumatic fever
• drug reaction (serum sickness)
• EARLY rheumatoid, connective tissue disease, vasculitis, seronegative: autoimmune ones turn CHRONIC

nodes.title: Course
lines: • episodic: crystals
• migratory: palindromic, rheumatic fever, early gonococcal

nodes.title: Wrists, knuckles, finger joints, ankles, feet
lines: • knuckles (MCPs) + middle finger joints (PIPs)
• distal finger joints (DIPs) SPARED
• also shoulders, elbows (MCPs, wrists also in pseudogout)
• ulnar deviation, knuckle subluxation · swan-neck, boutonnière

nodes.title: Extra-articular
lines: • rheumatoid nodules, lung nodules
• episcleritis

nodes.title: DIPs involved · dactylitis
lines: • sausage digit · enthesitis (Achilles)

nodes.title: Extra-articular
lines: • skin psoriasis · nail pitting
• uveitis

nodes.title: Spine and sacroiliac joints
lines: + a few large peripheral joints

nodes.title: Ask
lines: psoriasis · inflammatory bowel disease · recent infection

nodes.title: Weight-bearing joints, spine
lines: • DIPs, PIPs, thumb base, big toe

nodes.title: Hands
lines: Heberden's (DIP) and Bouchard's (PIP) nodes

nodes.title: Red, hot joint → ASPIRATE
lines: infection? crystals?
~gout: needles, negative · pseudogout: rhomboid, positive

nodes.title: Viral: serologies
lines: during or weeks after: hepatitis A, B, C · HIV, CMV, EBV · parvovirus · chikungunya · influenza · COVID-19
self-limited · supportive; anti-inflammatories or a short prednisone course if severe

nodes.title: Special labs
lines: • gout: uric acid
• pseudogout: look for hemochromatosis, hyperparathyroidism, hypothyroidism

nodes.title: Rheumatoid factor (RF) + anti-CCP: only if suspected
lines: • RF (IgM against IgG Fc): 70-80% of RA, 5-20% of healthy (↑ with age)
• RF also: Sjögren's, lupus, myositis · hepatitis B, C, TB, syphilis, endocarditis · lung fibrosis, silicosis, sarcoid · lymphoma
• anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide: 95% specific · present YEARS before arthritis
• order with true swollen joints + raised markers
• seropositive = more joints, erosions, extra-articular · NEVER to monitor

nodes.title: X-ray
lines: erosions, periarticular osteopenia, SYMMETRIC narrowing
• fusiform soft tissue swelling · periostitis · subluxation
• erosive: RA, psoriatic, SpA, gout, septic · NOT lupus, Sjögren's
~ little use early: damage takes years · baseline before treatment

nodes.title: No specific antibody
lines: clinical diagnosis · X-ray: erosions
detail: the SERONEGATIVE ARTHRITIDES chart

nodes.title: Human leukocyte antigen B27 (HLA-B27)
lines: X-ray: erosions
detail: the SERONEGATIVE ARTHRITIDES chart

nodes.title: X-ray
lines: osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis and cysts, ASYMMETRIC narrowing
erosions only in erosive OA · deviation from extra bone

panels.title: Tests
items: everyone: blood count (anemia of chronic disease, platelets ↑, autoimmune cytopenias) · creatinine (glomerulonephritis, vasculitis, drug clearance) · liver enzymes (drug clearance, autoimmune hepatitis) · CRP (ESR not routine)
ANA: up to 30% of healthy people · positive does NOT rule in, NEGATIVE rules out connective tissue disease · don't order ANA and RF reflexively
ENA: dsDNA, Sm → lupus · Ro, La → Sjögren's · centromere, Scl-70, RNA pol III → scleroderma · Jo-1 → myositis · RNP → mixed · histone → drug-induced lupus

panels.title: Management (briefly)
items: acetaminophen, NSAIDs · steroids: prednisone, IM methylprednisolone, joint injection
gout: colchicine, NSAIDs, steroids, allopurinol, febuxostat · pseudogout: colchicine, NSAIDs, steroids
gentle physio, strengthening · warm or cool compresses · rest

panels.title: Extra-articular clues for the rest
items: reactive arthritis: CONJUNCTIVITIS + URETHRITIS + arthritis (can't see, can't pee, can't climb a tree) · vesicopustular skin lesions
lupus: MALAR RASH · discoid lupus · oral ulcers · subacute lupus rash
dermatomyositis: heliotrope · GOTTRON'S sign and papules · shawl, V and holster signs · mechanic's hands
scleroderma: SCLERODACTYLY · Raynaud's · calcinosis · nail-fold capillary changes
organs: uveitis, scleritis, sicca · mouth ulcers · interstitial lung disease, effusions · pericarditis · glomerulonephritis · hemolysis, low platelets, lymphopenia · erythema nodosum, livedo
